subject: Request: Short cushion while PO routes — Novacare pilot
messages:
From: Asha Kapoor <asha@novacare.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novacare Procurement <procurement@novacare.com>, Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@novacare.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot details and next steps

Hi Grace,

Quick update from our side — legal and procurement asked us to route the PO through an additional vendor review. It looks like that will add 5–7 business days before finance signs off. The technical team is still happy with the environment and we'd like to keep the pilot running but the token window is tight.

I've attached a draft PO (filename: Novacare_PO_draft_5342.pdf) so you can see where things are expected to land. Any chance Redwood can provide a short cushion (tokens or time) while the PO clears? Obviously we hope it won't be necessary, but the delay could derail a planned demo next week.

Appreciate any flexibility — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Asha
Director, Digital Ops
Novacare

Attachments: Novacare_PO_draft_5342.pdf (pdf, 84KB)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha@novacare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Short cushion while PO routes — Novacare pilot

Hi Asha — thanks for the heads up and for sending the draft PO.

Short answer: yes, we can help.

Proposed plan:
- Provide a 7-day trial cushion on your existing sandbox (same token pool) starting immediately so the team can continue the demo and the customer-facing session next week.
- Cap: up to $1,200 of usage (approximate) under the cushion.
- If procurement clears earlier we’ll stop the cushion on sign-off; if the PO goes through as expected we’ll apply the usage to the initial month.

I’ve looped in Ben (your AE) and David from finance to confirm. Ben — can you confirm the customer-facing timelines and whether a brief call with Ravi/legal would help? David — please confirm we’re clear on the cap and any internal approvals needed.

If that sounds good to you, I’ll prepare a short approval note and start the cushion.

Thanks,
Grace
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---

Grace / David — I spoke with Asha on a quick call after her note. Customer demo is scheduled for Tue 6/8 and their customer success lead will present. If we lose environment access that demo is at risk and pipeline momentum will be impacted.

Agree with Grace's proposed cap. One small ask: can we also temporarily bump concurrency limits on the sandbox for the 48-hr window around that demo? They'll only need it for the live session. If that's too heavy operationally I can narrow the request to just token cushion.

I'll flag the demo in the deal notes (HubSpot: DEAL-9081) and be ready to escalate to product if we need a short spike.

—Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

> On Fri, Jun 5, 2027 at 10:05 AM Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval for temporary pilot cushion (Novacare)

Thanks for the context. Finance reviewed the draft PO and the deal history. Approving temporary cushion under the following conditions:

1) Cap confirmed at $1,200 total usage (non-recoupable if the PO never lands).
2) Cushion period limited to 7 calendar days starting when we enable it.
3) AE (Ben) must add an internal follow-up task to reconcile usage immediately after PO sign-off and mark the deal stage in HubSpot.

I'll enable the cushion but need a brief Ops ticket to lift the concurrency limit for the 48-hr demo window (if Ops confirms it's safe). Ben — please create the Ops ticket and ping me on approval.

—David
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Asha Kapoor <asha@novacare.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Novacare Procurement <procurement@novacare.com>, Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@novacare.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Short cushion while PO routes — Novacare pilot

Grace / Ben / David — this is fantastic, thank you. Please do enable the 7-day cushion and the concurrency bump for Tue 6/8 between 10:00–12:00 PT. I’ll ask procurement to prioritize the review and we’ll share any PO updates as soon as we have them.

Call me if anything else helps. Appreciate the quick turn.

Best,
Asha
Director, Digital Ops, Novacare
